node.title: Identity-prefix clean-anchor pair-budget and base-field classification
node.statement: For M=floor(q/2^t), the pair-root premise binom(M+1,2)k<q-n is impossible throughout the budget interval if Mk>=2^(t+1), and holds throughout it if binom(M+1,2)k<M2^t-n. At the six clean candidate predecessors this rules out the identity-prefix flexible-budget route on both RowC rates 1/4 and 1/8 and all three prize-max rates. On RowC rate 1/16 the pair premise passes, w=1, and the prefix premise holds exactly when a proved domain field has order at most 194309137781254382992506402317422272798923813601398339285841609906262.
node.notes: ROUTE CLASSIFICATION 2026-07-26: five clean anchors cannot use the harvested supplier; the only surviving branch requires a proved proper-domain-field pin, while the RowC characteristic remains unpinned. This narrows route ownership and proves no safe upper bound.
